A '''Givin''' was one of the crewmembers of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Hinthra]]'', which was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Elis Helrot/Legends|Elis Helrot]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] was one of [[Unidentified Givin 1|two]] who served, alongside a [[Unidentified Human (Hinthra)|Human male]], aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] when it took on the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] at the behest of the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mal Biron]].
